headline: Last session: Indian markets closed higher driven by IT stock gains as Nifty defies strong FPI selling

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 19 October.

why: IT stocks led gains in the recent trading sessions, boosting benchmark indices.
The strengthening Indian rupee supported gains across key market sectors.
Nifty defied a major foreign exodus despite heavy foreign portfolio investor selling.
FPI selling crossed Rs 52,000 crore in October, yet benchmark indices held up strong.
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, Sunday, 18 October 2026, for the weekend.
In recent trading, Sensex jumped 1,534 points and Nifty neared the 23,000 mark.
Foreign Portfolio Investors (FPIs) have pulled out over Rs 52,000 crore in October.
Market experts highlighted stocks like Mphasis, HAL, and Indian Hotel ahead of Monday's session.
summary:
The stock market is closed today, Sunday, October 18, due to the weekend and will reopen on Monday, October 19.
In the last trading session, Indian benchmark indices closed higher, led by significant gains in IT stocks.
Despite foreign portfolio investors pulling out over Rs 52,000 crore in October, Nifty continues to demonstrate resilience.
